SQL:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue",
    COUNT(*) AS "orders.n_orders"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name
), _cm_orders__order_items__id_count AS (
  SELECT
    orders__customers__regions.name AS "order_items.orders.customers.regions.name",
    COUNT(order_items.id) AS "order_items.id_count"
  FROM order_items AS order_items
  LEFT JOIN orders AS orders
    ON order_items.order_id = orders.id
  LEFT JOIN customers AS orders__customers
    ON orders.customer_id = orders__customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS orders__customers__regions
    ON orders__customers.region_id = orders__customers__regions.id
  GROUP BY
    orders__customers__regions.name
)
SELECT
  _base."orders.customers.regions.name",
  _base."orders.revenue",
  COALESCE(_cm_orders__order_items__id_count."order_items.id_count", 0) AS "orders.order_lines",
  _base."orders.n_orders"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__order_items__id_count
  ON _base."orders.customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__order_items__id_count."order_items.orders.customers.regions.name"
LIMIT 21
